feature1.hint_texts: This feature involves refactoring the core path resolution mechanism by removing the unique_path functionality. The changes must update the logic in the configuration and pathlib modules to use Path().resolve() rather than unique_path. This modification ensures that path resolution does not forcibly convert paths to lower case on Windows, thereby preventing the ImportError described in the problem statement. The aim is to provide a transparent transition so that existing functionality behaves as expected on case-insensitive file systems.
feature1.entrypoint: Modify src/_pytest/config/__init__.py by removing the import of unique_path and replacing its usage in functions such as _set_initial_conftests, _getconftestmodules, and _importconftest. Also update src/_pytest/pathlib.py by eliminating the unique_path function and any dependency on normcase, ensuring that Path().resolve() is used instead. These changes form the core logic that adjusts how conftest paths are handled.
